rows.grounds: vocative compound addressing one whose essence is beyond thought; acintya (inconceivable) + sāra (essence)
vocative compound identifying the addressee as the self of all; viśva (universe) + ātman (self)
vocative epithet naming the highest lord as the addressee

items.question: What nature of the supreme lord justifies the devotee's plea for grace?
premises: The supreme lord possesses an inconceivable essence.
The supreme lord is the self of the entire universe.
A lord of such nature is the proper recipient of a plea for grace.
items.inference: Therefore the devotee entreats the supreme lord, inconceivable in essence and universal in selfhood, to be gracious.
items.plain_english: O you of inconceivable essence, universal self, supreme lord, be gracious.
